effects.printed_clause: On activation optionally add an "Arckcestial", then discard 1, then LIGHT Spellcaster-only Special Summon lock; only 1 activation per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: Activation may decline the search; if accepted it adds/confirms/shuffles, discards, then registers the lock. Oath count applies to activation.

official_references.matched_structure: Reveal/search/discard hand handling and continuous card activation once-per-turn structure.

effects.printed_clause: Once per turn, if opponent Normal/Special Summons a non-LIGHT monster, except during Damage Step: target an "Arckcestial" in GY and Special Summon it.
effects.lua_implementation: Mandatory cloned Normal/Special Summon triggers detect an opponent-summoned non-LIGHT event monster, target a Necrovalley-legal Arckcestial in GY, and revive it. The effects do not carry EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_STEP, so—as in the official reference—they are unavailable during the Damage Step; SetCountLimit(1) is the printed SOPT.

official_references.matched_structure: Official summon trigger with an explicit Damage Step exclusion in condition/property handling.

coverage_override.reason: The activation search, discard, LIGHT Spellcaster lock, and activation HOPT form one compound activation effect. The opponent non-LIGHT Summon trigger, Damage Step exclusion, target/revival, and SOPT form the second.
